{{Otheruses|Hyperdrive}}
'''"Hyperdrive"''' was a song popular on the [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[Holovid/Legends|holo-market]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At around the same time, "[[Light the Sky on Fire]]," a song performed by a [[Unidentified Human band|band]] of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Musician/Legends|musicians]], was also a hit on Kashyyyk.<ref name="Slugthrowers 2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"Hyperdrive" is the title of a [[1974]] song by [[Jefferson Starship]], the band who appeared as holographic musicians performing "Light the Sky on Fire" in [[1978]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''. "Hyperdrive" was originally featured on their 1974 album, [[Wikipedia:Dragon Fly (album)|''Dragon Fly'']].<ref name="Dragon Fly">{{WebCite|url=https://www.discogs.com/release/1866583-Jefferson-Starship-Dragon-Fly|text=Jefferson Starship – Dragon Fly – Vinyl (Indianapolis Pressing, LP, Album, Stereo), 1974|archivedate=20250622004837}}</ref>

Two releases of the "Light the Sky on Fire" single included "Hyperdrive" as a B-side, one of which was a ''Holiday Special'' tie-in.<ref name="SWHS.com">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com/merchandise/jefferson_starship.htm|text=Discussion of the "Light the Sky on Fire" single|work=[http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com Star Wars Holiday Special.com]|archivedate=20031209105641}}</ref> Both "Light the Sky on Fire" and "Hyperdrive" also appear on Jefferson Starship's 1979 greatest hits compilation, [[Wikipedia:Gold (Jefferson Starship album)|''Gold'']].<ref name="Gold">{{WebCite|url=https://www.discogs.com/release/1606591-Jefferson-Starship-Gold|text=Jefferson Starship – Gold – Vinyl (Gatefold, Terre Haute, LP, Compilation, Stereo), 1979|archivedate=20251021125925}}</ref>

"Hyperdrive" was mentioned alongside "Light the Sky on Fire" in [[Edward M. Erdelac|Ed Erdelac]]'s [[Star Wars Blog]] article [[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|''Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away, Part 2'']], though it was not confirmed to be identical to the real-world song or performed by the same group as "Light the Sky on Fire".<ref name="Slugthrowers 2" />
